about: Authentic treat-page media supplied by the owner (handoff/Cater_Ice_Cream_WebP_Assets/treats). Asset keys are stable identifiers: the importer finds attachments by the _cic_asset_id meta (the same identifier the image-pack importer uses), never by local IDs or URLs. Files are built by build-treat-media.cjs into a media package; originals are never modified.

crop.why: Leaves out the easel sign on the right, which shows the couple's first names and wedding date.
